QuestInfo.name: The Stolen Seal Stone of Mu Lung
QuestInfo.0: You lost the Seal Stone of Mu Lung. What does this mean? You'd better head over to #b#m104000000##k and talk to #b#p1002104##k to get some advice.
QuestInfo.1: When you tell #p1002104# about everything that took place in #m250000000#, #p1002104# felt it was necessary for you to tell #b#p1201000##k in #b#m140000000##k about it.
QuestInfo.2: #p1201000# suggested you research heroes, since they are the ones who brought the Seal Stone to town.

0.1:
Is #o9300352# getting in the way again? The Black Wings certainly aren't pushovers... As long as you get stronger, I know you'll be able to stop them next time. 
#p1201000# knows a lot about the heroes and will probably get some useful facts out of all this. Go tell #bLilin#k what's happening. 
I'll contact you again if I get any information on the Black Wings. Send #p1201000# my regards.

#b(When you accept, you will move immediately to Rien.)#k
0.0: Hey, you're back. How did the thing in #m250000000# go? Well, you don't look too happy, which means things didn't go as planned. What happened?\n#b#L0#(You tell him about the Seal Stone of Mu Lung.)#l\n#k

no.0: Aran, you may be a hero and all, but you need to loosen up a bit.

npc.0: You haven't gone to see #b#p1201000##k yet? Don't let your failures get you down. #p1201000# won't even bat an eye because she knows what's really important.
